ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.3:1 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-gray) to low-intensity (dark-gray/black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast mottling characterized by hundreds of contiguous white circular rings (rosettes) against a dominant dark-gray field, with high-density clusters mapped to the lateral distal regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Defined V-shaped depression with a pixel-calculated angle of approximately 68 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 12% of the visible lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency serration along both trailing edges, featuring irregular peak-to-valley pixel amplitudes ranging from 3 to 12 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve fitted to the trailing edge boundaries, sweeping upward and outward from the median notch vertex to the terminal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast pixel rings (5-15px diameter) across the entire visible surface, representing dense barnacle colonization/scarring sites.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive superficial scarring appearing as high-intensity circular 'rosette' marks across over 60% of the visible ventral pixel area.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'donut' morphology of pigmentation markers where high-intensity outer rings encapsulate low-intensity centers, distributed uniformly across both lobes.
